entities.summary: Robert Montague "Monty" Wilkinson is an American lawyer who has spent his entire career at the Justice Department. He served as acting United States Attorney General from January 20 to March 11, 2021. Wilkinson was the director of the Executive Office for United States Attorneys from 2021-2023.
